Privacy & data protection

Minimal collection. Clear boundaries.

This policy covers mevlanayalcin.com.tr, product documentation, and the Yankı private-preview waitlist.

Business enquiries

When you email info@mevlanayalcin.com.tr, we process the contact details and project context you send solely to reply and perform contracted engineering work. Do not send secret keys, credentials or regulated personal records.

Product examples & disabled public inference

Hosted Yankı Cloud execution is currently in active development and disabled on the public website. The trace explorer on /work/yanki/ displays pre-verified reference examples locally in your browser; visitors do not submit free-text prompts to an external language model on this site.

Private preview waitlist

If you submit your email address to join the Yankı private-preview queue, we store your email address, timestamp, language preference and referral page in Cloudflare KV solely to notify you about preview availability. Write to us anytime for immediate removal.

Edge protection & zero ad tracking

Cloudflare serves and protects this domain and processes standard network metadata (such as IP rate-limiting counters on the waitlist endpoint). We include zero advertising pixels, third-party analytics scripts or session-replay trackers.

Contact & deletion requests

Send access, correction or deletion requests to info@mevlanayalcin.com.tr. Data controller: Mevlana Yalçın, Ankara, Türkiye.

Turkish data protection (KVKK)

Mevlana Yalçın is the data controller (veri sorumlusu) under Law No. 6698 (KVKK). Personal data submitted via email or the preview waitlist is processed exclusively for communication and service onboarding, is never sold or shared with advertising networks, and is deleted once no longer required. Written KVKK requests are answered free of charge within thirty days.

Engineering & partnerships

Discuss an architecture audit or private preview access.

Tell us about your retrieval pipeline, target languages, runtime constraints and timeline. Enquiries go directly to the founder.
